name: Pipeline imbalance resolution
definition: Reconciling gas imbalances with pipelines and counterparties, exchanging volume statements and agreeing how the imbalance is cleared.

row.stall_summary: Rounds wait on the other party: the Hub sends park and loan information late, a counterparty has no answer yet on why actuals differed, and an expected wire transfer is chased for over a week.
row.fix: A scheduled report that pulls measured and scheduled volumes per meter, contract and interconnect, flags differences beyond a tolerance, and produces the reconciliation spreadsheet and supporting statements by month, plus a written procedure naming the owner of the daily imbalance check and the steps for clearing imbalances the system cannot clear.
row.status_line: Not drafted: $43 a month is under the $85 drafting line

synthesis.description: Schedulers and pipeline account staff compare measured against scheduled or confirmed volumes at meters and interconnects, find where actuals did not come in as scheduled, and agree with the pipeline or counterparty how the imbalance is cleared: lending or parking gas, shifting nominations, paying back volumes in kind, or making manual book entries when the system cannot clear it. Rounds trade spreadsheets, OBA imbalance reports and volume statements, and ask the other side to verify or update contract and meter lists.
steps: A scheduler or the pipeline notices that actual volumes at a meter or contract differ from scheduled or confirmed volumes.
Staff pull measured versus scheduled volumes and prepare a spreadsheet or imbalance report by contract.
The report or a list of meters and contracts goes to the counterparty or pipeline to verify, add or update.
Both sides compare their numbers and request statements to support any volume differences by month.
The parties agree how to clear the imbalance: lend or park gas, adjust nominations, or pay back volumes.
Where the system cannot clear it, accounting makes manual entries to clear the imbalance from the books.
synthesis.approach: A scheduled report that pulls measured and scheduled volumes per meter, contract and interconnect, flags differences beyond a tolerance, and produces the reconciliation spreadsheet and supporting statements by month, plus a written procedure naming the owner of the daily imbalance check and the steps for clearing imbalances the system cannot clear.
synthesis.rationale: The mail shows the same reconciliation spreadsheets rebuilt by hand and confusion over who owns the daily check and who signs off. A written procedure that fixes ownership, sign-off and the manual-entry path addresses the stalls directly, while the comparison report takes over the volume pulling.
